system.description:
A Jonin woman is flying through the clouds with wings made of paper over her target fortress. She touches her neck and begins to speak through a radio device. “I spotted them. Do I begin the assault?” she speaks and awaits a response. “No, do not engage. If you engage you will be alone!” a voice echo’s through her receiver. “I only asked for formalities darling. You never really had a choice in the matter.” She responds coldly before she flies down and begins to weave handseals as shuriken and kunai made of paper begin to fire downwards exploding on impact with the building.

—Zozo Yamanaka

At Worlds End, Ch. 18 excerpt.

A Work of Art

The Shikigami Clan is not a clan bound by blood as much as it is a clan bound by ideology. This Shikigami clan has no surname, and do not share any connecting tissue outside of the passed down secrets of Papercraft. This family works more like a coven of members more so than a bloodline, with senior and elder members teaching their children and bringing in those from outside the clan into the fold.

Shikigami Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Int, +1 Dex

Speed: 30 feet.

Skill Proficiencies: Crafting, Sleight of Hand

Tool Proficiencies: Trappers Kit

Shikigami Techniques: The Shikigami Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hijutsu Flexibility: Shikigami Clan Hijutsu can use either Dexterity or Intelligence as its casting ability score.

Paper Craft: At the conclusion of any Short or Long rest, you can craft two Ninja Tools with the word Tag in its name (Ex. Explosive Tag, Flash Tag, Sealing Tag etc.) of D-Rank. This increases to C-Rank at 7th level and B-Rank at 15th level.

Shikigami Features

Blank Canvas

1st Level Clan Feature

You know how to make something as simple as paper both beautiful, and dangerous.

While in combat, as a Bonus Action, you can call upon this paper, making your body appear to be formed entirely of Thousands of layers of paper, entering into your Paper Veil battle state, lasting until the end of combat. This Paper Veil battle state is refined around your Canvas Type. Select one Canvas Type, this choice cannot be changed later. You gain an additional selection at 7th and 15th levels. You can select the same Canvas Type additional times, further cementing your form of paper craft which is signified by the Craft I and Craft II additional effects listed with each Canvas Type. Alternatively, you can select a different Canvas Type, gaining the base version when you reach 7th or 15th levels.

Paper Veil abilities use your highest jutsu save DC, for effects that call for it.

Explosive Veil

Your Paper is laced with explosive formulas, primed to detonate on contact or command. While your Paper Veil is active, you can spend a Bonus Action to launch your paper at a target point you can see within 60 feet, filling a 10-foot cube. You can decide to either detonate on arrive, or leave as a trap hiding all of the explosive paper across the ground.

Detonate on Arrival. All creatures within the affected area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 3d6 fire damage. This increases to 5d6 at 7th level and 7d6 at 15th level.

Set Trap. This trap is set and remains until the end of combat and can be destroyed if a damaging area or attack would cross with or interact with this space. A hostile creature that moves within the affected area triggers it, forcing themselves and all creatures within 15 feet of the triggering space to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 4d6 fire damage. This increases to 6d6 at 7th level and 8d6 at 15th level.

Craft I: Creatures caught in the detonation range have residual tags adhere to them, which last until the start of your next turn. As a Reaction, before the beginning of your next turn, you can detonate them, forcing all tagged creatures to remake their saving throws, being Staggered on a failure.

Craft II: If this was detonated on arrival, then all affected creatures gain 2 ranks of the Burned condition. If this was detonated as a trap, then all affected creatures gain 3 ranks of the Burned condition.

Serrated Veil

Your Paper is the thinnest it could possibly be, while still having a firmness to it that could cut less careful hands. While your Paper Veil is active, you are encircled by floating origami made of this sharpened paper. The first time on a turn that a hostile creature of your choice would be within 10 feet of you, or begin their turn within 5 feet of you must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 slashing damage and gaining 1 rank of Bleed on a failure or no effects on a success. This increases to 3d6 and 2 ranks at 7th level and 3d6 and 3 ranks at 15th level.

Craft I: Shikigami Clan Hijutsu that deal piercing or slashing damage deals +4 bonus damage and increase the size of your aura to 10 feet.

Craft II: Creatures that fail their saving throw is Slowed on a failed save.

Binding Veil

Your Paper is inscribed with a chakra rejecting formula that disrupts the flow of chakra of creatures it finds itself attached to. While your Paper Veil is active, you can spend your Action to select two points you can see within 60 feet of you, generating a 10-foot radius that has floating and fluttering binding tags all throughout called your Binding Field. You can have up to 2 Binding Fields at once. Creating a Binding Field beyond your limit dismisses the oldest one. Creatures that cast jutsu while within your Binding Field, increases the cost of jutsu they cast by +4. This increases to +6 at 7th and +8 at 15th level.

Craft I: As a Bonus Action, you can move your already set Binding Fields, up to 30 feet, centered on a new point from their current position.

Craft II: The Binding Field Increases in size to a 20-foot radius, centered on the chosen point.

Weaving Veil

You fold dense overlapping layers of chakra enhanced paper around your body, covering you like an extra layer of muscle, enhancing your speed and strength to match your refined chakra control. While your Paper Veil is active, you gain the benefits of the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance.

Muscle Weave. Your strikes are controlled via your chakra controlling your paper covered form.

You can benefit from a Taijutsu or Bukijutsu stance, while in this stance.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6 and a rank of Mastery to your [Unarmed Damage] rolls. This increases to two ranks at 11th level.

Unarmed attacks you make can use your clans Hijutsu ability modifier as defined by Hijutsu Flexibility while in this stance to make unarmed attacks and calculate [Unarmed Damage].

If do not have the Extra Attack feature, then beginning at 7th level, you can make two attacks with this attack, instead of one.

Craft I: You gain the Spiral Weave ability, which can only be used once per turn as an Action or in place of an Unarmed attack made while you are in the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance.

Spiral Weave. Make melee attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature within 15 feet of you, as you turn your paper into a large spiraling drill, tearing into whoever is in its way. On a hit, you deal 5d6 piercing damage and force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, being Staggered on a failure.

Craft II: You gain the Execution Weave ability, which can only be used once per turn as an Action or in place of an Unarmed attack made while you are in the Muscle Weave Chakra Stance You cannot use this ability if you’ve used Spiral Weave this turn, and if you use this ability, you cannot use Spiral Weave, in the same turn.

Execution Weave. For all creatures in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line originating from you to make a Dexterity saving throw, as you turn your paper into a compressed spiraling spear, tearing through everything in its way. On a failure, affected creatures take 5d6 piercing damage are Staggered and Dazed, or half as much damage on a success.

Origami

3rd Level Clan Feature

The Shikigami embodies a shinobi who specializes in preparation. Every move is calculated, and every fold has a purpose. You translate this into combat by constantly designing, and building origami one-fold at a time. At the beginning of each of your turns, or the first time each turn you cast a Shikigami Hijutsu, you summon a floating Origami called a Rei. These Rei can take any shape or design of your choice. They are charged with your chakra, and once per turn, can be spent on any of the following abilities. You can maintain up to 4 Rei at any given time, and can only generate them while in combat, or as an Action while out of combat. Effects that require a saving throw use your highest jutsu save DC. Spending two or more Rei, grants you the previous benefits as well as the upgraded benefits.

Origami Turtle. When a hostile creature deals damage to an allied creature within 30 feet of you, you can spend 1 Rei to interpose the Rei, and generate a chakra barrier with 1d10 + half your level hit points. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei increase the barriers hit points by +1d10. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei increase the barriers hit points by +1d10.

Origami Snake. As a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend 1 Rei to fling a coiling origami snake inscribed with a sealing formula at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the snake wraps around them, reducing their speed by half, and they cannot move further than 30 feet away from you until the end of their next turn. They can spend their Action on their turn, to tear the snake, ending this effect immediately. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei they are also pulled Prone. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei they also have their speed reduced to 0.

Origami Bird. As a bonus action on your turn, you spend 1 Rei to place a small origami bird onto a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. This even occurs secretly unless the target creature has Chakra Sight or Chakra Sense. A creature remains marked in this way for 10 minutes and you always know this creatures location, regardless of concealment, invisibility, walls or barriers. A creature that spends 1 Action to perform the Search action can find the bird, destroying it. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei A creature marked in this way cannot make attacks at advantage against you. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei so long as they are within 120 feet of you, Shikigami Hijutsu or features with a range of at least 5 feet and doesn’t affect an area, can reach the marked creature.

Origami Rabbit. When a construct is summoned or commanded to act or move by a hostile creature, you can spend your Reaction and 1 Rei to disrupt its command, forcing the controlling creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature wastes their action commanding it. Beginning at 7th level, the creature follows your one command in place of their summoners until the end of the current turn. Beginning at 15th level, you can command them on your own turn, until the end of your turn.

Secret Pages

| #### Origami Angel/Demon / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Living Paper. You instead generate 2 Rei at the start of each of your turns. / Paper Shroud. You gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus at the beginning of each of your turns. / Angel Form / These benefits are only available to Shikigami with Binding Veil or Explosive Veil as their first Canvas Type. / Paper Wings. White angel like wings of paper grants you’re a 60-foot fly speed. / Veil Enhancement (Binding). Increase the number of Binding Fields you can have to 4. / Veil Enhancement (Explosive). Your Set Trap Detonations force the triggering creature to make their saving throws at disadvantage. / Demon Form / These benefits are only available to Shikigami with Serrated Veil or Weaving Veil as their first Canvas Type. / Paper Surge. Dark paper covers your body, allowing you to, once per turn as a Bonus Action, surge forward, teleporting into a space you can see within 30 feet of you. Draw a line from your previous space to your new space, recording it. If you are using Serrated Veil, each creature this line pass through or by, within 5 feet suffers the effects of your serrated aura, making their saving throw as normal. If you are using Weaving Veil, you can make one unarmed strike against each creature the line passes through or by, within 5 feet, adding +2d6 to the damage result. / Veil Enhancement (Serrated). Your aura expands, doubling in size. / Veil Enhancement (Weaving). When you take the Attack Action, increase the number of attacks you can make by +1. Also, Spiral Weave and Extinction Weave saving throws cannot be made at advantage. |

7th Level Clan Feature

While technology has advanced, people still entrusted their secrets to ink and paper. Normally, your pen and paper cannot be breached by a flawed security system. Unfortunately, a Shikigami can hack a book just as well as a hacker hacks a computer or use Paper to steal state secrets.

By spending 10 minutes working with your papercraft, you can accomplish one of the following.

Paper Mask. You construct a physical disguise made of paper for yourself or a willing creature, reshaping the creatures appearance size and even shape. It lasts for 8 hours; the creature takes damage or they are submerged in water.

Paper Scout. You animate a Rei as a scout, sending it ahead. It has a fly speed of 60 feet and can pass through any gap large enough for a sheet of paper to slip through, but it has 1 hit point. You cannot control it during its recon. Whatever it see’s is inscribe on it as text until both sides of it is filled with information. This information is basic in that it only describes creatures as humanoid or animal like, simple colors, shapes and terrain. If the scout is wet or captured, it dissolves and you become aware of its destruction. You can only have one scout active at a time.

Paper Forgery. You take any copy of a document or scroll, and you can perfectly emulate its contents. A creature can only discern it’s a forgery if they can make a successful Investigation check vs your highest jutsu save DC.

Kami’s Salvation/ Akuma’s Damnation

11th Level Clan Feature

You’ve reached the point where your origami stops being something you use to express your ideals but instead becomes something you use to enforce your prophetic beliefs upon your fallen foe. You either present as an Angel sent by a Kami, or a Demon summoned by an Akuma.

As a Bonus Action you can become an Origami Angel/Demon for the next minute. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.

The Final Page

15th Level Clan Feature

You have created your ultimate expression of art and origami. Your final shape. Once per Long Rest, you can saturate every surface within a 60-foot radius, centered on you (This radius does not move with you) or a point of your choice within 120 feet of you with your first Canvas Type for 1 minute, or until you are incapacitated.

Scorched Page (Explosive Veil). Hostile creatures that begin their turns within this radius must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 fire damage and are Staggered on a failure.

Bleeding Edge (Serrated Veil). Hostile creatures that move 10 or more feet on a turn within the radius gains 1 rank of Bleed. A Hostile creature that doesn’t move on their turn takes 2d6 slashing damage at the end of their turn.

Sealed Page (Binding Veil). Hostile creatures that begins their turns concentrating on a jutsu, gain 1 rank of Sealed.

Crushed Page (Weaving Veil). [Unarmed Damage] you deal within this area, is rolled twice taking the higher roll, and are made with a rank of Mastery to their attack rolls and if you score 2 or more hits with an Unarmed attack against the same creature as part of the same Action, they are knocked Prone with no saving throw.
